events.title: Alan Turing Proposes the Imitation Game
events.description: Alan Turing publishes Computing Machinery and Intelligence, introducing the imitation game as a way to explore whether machines can demonstrate intelligent behavior.

events.title: Artificial Intelligence Becomes a Research Field
events.description: The Dartmouth Summer Research Project brings researchers together to explore machine intelligence and helps establish artificial intelligence as a formal field of study.

events.title: The Perceptron
events.description: Frank Rosenblatt demonstrates the perceptron, an early neural network model designed to learn patterns from examples.

events.title: ELIZA Demonstrates Early Conversation
events.description: Joseph Weizenbaum creates ELIZA, a computer program that simulates conversation using pattern matching and scripted responses.

events.title: MYCIN and Expert Systems
events.description: Researchers at Stanford begin developing MYCIN, a rule-based system designed to assist with identifying bacterial infections and recommending antibiotic treatments.

events.title: Backpropagation Advances Neural Networks
events.description: David Rumelhart, Geoffrey Hinton, and Ronald Williams publish influential research demonstrating how backpropagation can train multilayer neural networks.

events.title: Deep Blue Defeats Garry Kasparov
events.description: IBM's Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov in a six-game match, demonstrating the power of specialized computer systems in strategic decision-making.

events.title: ImageNet Accelerates Computer Vision
events.description: ImageNet provides a large labeled image dataset that becomes a major resource for training and evaluating computer vision systems.

events.title: AlexNet Transforms Image Recognition
events.description: AlexNet achieves a major improvement in the ImageNet competition, demonstrating the effectiveness of deep convolutional neural networks trained using GPUs.

events.title: AlphaGo Defeats Lee Sedol
events.description: Google DeepMind's AlphaGo defeats professional Go player Lee Sedol in a five-game match, demonstrating advances in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

events.title: The Transformer Architecture
events.description: Researchers publish Attention Is All You Need, introducing the Transformer architecture that becomes foundational to many modern large language models.

events.title: GPT-3 Demonstrates Large-Scale Language Generation
events.description: OpenAI introduces GPT-3, a large language model that demonstrates strong few-shot learning and text-generation capabilities.

events.title: ChatGPT Launches Publicly
events.description: OpenAI releases ChatGPT as a research preview, making conversational generative AI widely accessible and prompting new debates about education, work, and trust.

events.title: GPT-4 Advances Multimodal AI
events.description: OpenAI introduces GPT-4, a model capable of processing text and image inputs, demonstrating improved performance across many complex tasks.

events.title: The EU AI Act Enters Into Force
events.description: The European Union's AI Act enters into force, establishing a risk-based regulatory framework for artificial intelligence, with requirements applying in phases.
